correctness.rationale: The function \(\phi_a=\max\{0,\log|z_1|+a\}\) is a finite maximum of plurisubharmonic functions, is continuous and bounded, and is not pluriharmonic because its first-coordinate restriction has a radial corner. For a direction \(\xi\), the restriction is identically zero iff \(|\xi_1|\le e^{-a}\), and otherwise has an interior radial corner. The exact sphere law \(|\xi_1|^2\sim\operatorname{Beta}(1,n-1)\) gives bad-direction measure \((1-e^{-2a})^{n-1}\), which can be made smaller than any prescribed positive tolerance.
